set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switch.explanation: Configures the interface with trunk exchange mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: port-mode
parameters.explanation: Port mode for interfaces, such as trunk.

unit [parameter2] encapsulation vlan-id.explanation: Configure the VLAN envelope for the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify different VLANs.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

ether-options 802.3ad [parameter2].explanation: Configure the interface with an etho-net option of 802.3ad and bind it to the polymer interface.

parameters.name: aggregated-interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the polymer interface, e.g. ae0.

unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switch.explanation: Configure the Ethernet exchange function for interfaces.

parameters.name: unit
